recommendation: Keep the commit as-is as a non-substantive terminology fix. If the work group wants a broader terminology purge, review remaining invariant occurrences separately because some are actual element names, historical terminology, generated renderer tooltips, or external tooling text.
issue_request: FHIR-43488 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 and asked that Detailed Descriptions/tooling/templates use "constraint" instead of "invariant" when constraint is intended.
initial_application: No FHIR-43488-tagged core source commit was found. Current CI detailed-description pages for Observation and StructureDefinition already render constraint sections as "Constraints", but source/formats.html and tools/ig/sd.html still had stale invariant-facing labels.
additional_context: FHIR-I WGM minutes corroborate the 11-0-0 tracker vote. OO comments noted that the Observation example labels were controlled by shared tooling. tools/ig/ig.json maps StructureDefinition pages to tools/ig/sd.html, so the template is in the tooling/template scope. Technical names such as contextInvariant and historical invariant terminology were left for separate case-by-case review.
reconciliation: Changed source/formats.html from the stale I/invariants flag example to C/constraints and changed tools/ig/sd.html from an Invariants heading to Constraints.
source_changes: source/formats.html: changed the logical-table example tooltip from invariants to constraints and the flag from I to C; changed the Key to Flags entry from I to C.
tools/ig/sd.html: changed the StructureDefinition template heading from Invariants to Constraints.
